statements.impact_statement: CVE-2025-47909 is in gorilla/csrf's TrustedOrigins handling: a host listed in TrustedOrigins is also trusted over plain HTTP. Zoraxy 3.3.4 configures csrf.Protect at src/main.go:125-131 with CookieName, Secure(false), Path and SameSite only, and never calls csrf.TrustedOrigins anywhere in its source (checked with grep -rn TrustedOrigins src at v3.3.4: no match). Without TrustedOrigins the origin check compares against the request host only, so the trusted-origin path never runs. The build fails if csrf.TrustedOrigins ever appears in the source. No fixed gorilla/csrf release exists; 1.7.3 is the newest.
